unitTitle: Travel across the city and beyond
title: TCF corner
subtitle: A2 · Unit 9: Travel across the city and beyond

steps.title: Exam style
steps.body: These questions look like the real TCF Canada: one play, four options, one answer. A wrong and a blank answer both score zero, so always choose.

steps.fr: Le trajet change aujourd'hui. L'employée indique l'arrêt provisoire près du carrefour.
steps.question: What should a traveller ask for?
steps.explain: The first instruction is to ask the staff member for the temporary stop.

steps.fr: Nous allons au centre communautaire. Je vais leur demander l'heure de départ.
steps.question: Who will the speaker ask?

steps.fr: La bibliothèque est près du carrefour. Nous y allons après le cours.
steps.question: Where are the speakers going after class?
steps.explain: Y refers to the previously named library.
The notice places the temporary stop near the intersection.
steps.promptFr: AVIS — Arrêt provisoire près du carrefour. La ligne express va au centre communautaire.

steps.prompt: What does Karim ask Nadia to give the group?
steps.explain: The message asks Nadia to give them the departure time.
steps.promptFr: Bonjour Nadia, je suis au terminus. Peux-tu leur donner l'heure de départ ? Merci, Karim

options: At the main entrance of the community centre
steps.explain: The notice gives the community centre's main entrance as the meeting point.
steps.promptFr: RENDEZ-VOUS — Le groupe attend près de l'entrée principale du centre communautaire à 14 h.
